description: This file contains C source code implementing NMEA GPS data parsing functions, including handling of GPGGA and GPRMC sentences, coordinate conversions, checksum validation, and related utilities.

methods.name: long hex2int(char * a,int len)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string segment to an integer value.

methods.name: int str2int(char * a,int len)
methods.description: Converts a numeric string segment to an integer.

methods.name: float gps_deg_dec(float deg_point)
methods.description: Converts degrees in D°MM.MMMM format to decimal degrees.

methods.name: void gps_convert_deg_to_dec(float * latitude,char ns,float * longitude,char we)
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude from degrees to decimal degrees considering N/S and E/W indicators.

methods.name: int str_till_comma(char * a,char * dStr)
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a comma-separated string up to the comma.

methods.name: void nmea_parse_gpgga(char * nmea,loc_t * loc)
methods.description: Parses a GPGGA NMEA sentence to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: void nmea_parse_gprmc(char * nmea,loc_t * loc)
methods.description: Parses a GPRMC NMEA sentence to extract recommended minimum GPS data.

methods.name: nmea_message_type nmea_get_message_type(const char * message)
methods.description: Determines the message type of a NMEA sentence.

methods.name: int nmea_valid_checksum(const char * message)
methods.description: Validates the NMEA checksum to verify message integrity.

methods.name: void gps_location(loc_t * coord,char * buffer)
methods.description: Processes a NMEA message buffer and fills a loc_t structure with parsed GPS data.
